name: notehub
description: NoteHub - a student notes sharing platform with React, Express and MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.format: prettier --write src server tests public/theme-init.js index.html vite.config.js package.json README.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src server tests public/theme-init.js index.html vite.config.js package.json README.md .prettierrc.json
